quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: If two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, what should happen?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
The vehicle on the right must yield to the vehicle on the left.
Drivers must use hand signals to communicate with each other.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles should go in the order they arrive. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.

questions.question: What is the purpose of highway markings?

options.text: They are only found in construction zones.
They are usually red and blue.

questions.explanation: Highway markings help drivers position their vehicles correctly, show safe passing areas, and warn about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If a police officer is directing traffic at a working traffic light, what should drivers do?

options.text: Do what the cars next to them are doing.

questions.explanation: Traffic lights help prevent crashes. When a police officer is directing traffic, drivers, pedestrians, and cyclists must follow the officer's directions instead of the traffic light.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is used only on one-way streets.
You may go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
You may proceed only if the green arrow is with a circular green light.
It shows the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go like a regular green light, but you must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: How can drivers avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to the vehicle for better grip.
Leave the highway as fast as possible.
Drive slower and stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slower and stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: The best ways to avoid crashes on snow or ice are to slow down and increase the distance between your car and the car ahead. This gives you more time to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows a law drivers must obey. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions. A broken line means drivers next to it may pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Your car hits a parked car with no one around. You cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: You must wait for police to arrive.
You must leave a written note with your name, address, and details of the accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must leave a written note with your name, address, and details of the accident.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked car and cannot find the owner, you must leave a written note. Include your name, address, and what happened.

questions.question: Before turning left, you should:

options.text: Move to the right side of your lane.
Wait until oncoming traffic gets a red light.

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic light, you must let oncoming vehicles and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you about an intersection ahead.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you must:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear. Only go when it is safe. At railroad crossings, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Stop and wait until the lights stop flashing before crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic moving in both directions ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moving in both directions ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means you cannot do that action. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should NOT:

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.
Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors for traffic behind you. Signal to let other drivers know. Look for other drivers who may be moving into the same lane. Never use your cell phone while driving.

questions.question: Which drugs can affect your driving?
questions.explanation: Many drugs can affect your driving. This includes illegal drugs and over-the-counter or prescription medicines. Driving while impaired by any drug is a crime.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the side of the road with no one inside.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are not flashing.
When its red lights are flashing and you are both on a two-lane road.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: When its red lights are flashing and you are both on a two-lane road.
questions.explanation: Stop when you see a school bus with flashing red lights. The bus is picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic in both directions must stop and stay stopped while the red lights are flashing or the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle approaches with its siren and/or flashing lights, you must immediately:

options.text: Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the right and slow down.
Pull to the right and turn on your four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle uses its lights and sirens, you must drive to the right side of the road and stop immediately.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: You are waiting at an intersection to turn left. You should:

options.text: Signal and keep your wheels turned to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to tell drivers to let you through.
Drive around the back of a car blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another vehicle hits you from behind, straight wheels prevent you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: The best way to handle tailgaters is to:

options.text: Speed up to increase distance between you.
Brake hard to make them back off.
Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.
questions.explanation: Watch your mirrors often for tailgaters or fast-approaching cars. If a car is too close, slow down gradually to let it pass. Most rear-end crashes happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: Signs for public recreation areas are:
questions.explanation: Brown signs mark areas of cultural, historical, or recreational interest. They help you find these places when traveling.

questions.question: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an approaching emergency vehicle, you must:

options.text: Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
Wave the emergency vehicle to pass you.
Merge into the right lane and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: Give the right-of-way to any emergency vehicle using flashing lights or a siren. Drive to the right side of the road and stop until it passes. If you are in an intersection, drive through first, then stop on the right.

questions.question: The fastest speed for backing up is:
questions.explanation: Back up very slowly, never faster than 10 mph. Your vehicle is harder to control and stop when backing.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, you should:

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show they are wrong.
Do something to get back at them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and get out of the aggressive driver's way. Fighting back can make the situation worse and more dangerous.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers:

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on a road to your left and you reach an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: Yield to other drivers when entering from a driveway, alley, or garage. Also yield to pedestrians on intersecting sidewalks.

questions.question:
When do you need a driver license?
    I. Sitting in the driver's seat with the engine running.
    II. Steering a car while it is being pushed or towed.
questions.explanation: You must have a valid driver license to sit in the driver's seat while the engine is running. You also need a license to steer a car while another vehicle is pushing or towing it.

questions.question: When entering a public road from a driveway or private road, what should you do?

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
Assume other drivers will change lanes for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: When entering traffic from a driveway or private road, you must yield to drivers already on the public road. Merge safely when it is clear to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: Which traffic signal gives you the right-of-way to turn left?
questions.explanation: A green arrow lets you turn in the direction the arrow points. Oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.question: If a flagger is directing traffic in a construction zone, you must:

options.text: Do what other cars are doing, even if it goes against the flagger's instructions.
Assume the flagger should not be there.
Follow the normal traffic laws instead.

questions.explanation: Always follow directions from flaggers, signs, and police officers in construction zones. Ignoring them is illegal and dangerous to workers.

questions.question: If a crossing guard is directing traffic in a school zone, you must:

options.text: Do what other cars are doing, even if it goes against the crossing guard's instructions.
Assume the guard should not be there.
Follow rules that would apply if no children were present.

questions.explanation: Always follow directions from crossing guards, signs, and police officers in school zones. Drive slowly and carefully in school zones.
